cases.input: Six outputs are dispatched but only five are received.
cases.expect: Transformation of S1..S10, stock postings, shipment SH of S1..S6, receipt of five units, the S6 damage exception and acceptance remain five separately asserted facts; S6 is dispatched, not delivered, not accepted.

cases.input: A stock position for lot L at site W is taken from an authoritative source system with no movement ledger available.
cases.expect: derivationMode authoritative-source-snapshot is declared on the position; no completenessPerimeterRef is required; the position authorizes no posting and no adjustment.

cases.input: A balance for lot L is projected over WM-FLW-012 postings and their corrections within a declared closed perimeter.
cases.expect: derivationMode complete-ledger-projection with completenessPerimeterRef, ledgerCutoffRecordTime and correctionsIncluded true; the projection is labelled derived and authorizes no posting.

cases.input: Shipment SH carrying S1..S6 is bound for a sale under one commercial agreement moved by one carrier.
cases.expect: WM-FLW-011 is reused with kind trade-shipment explicitly declared, and the transport-consignment view is a separate declared kind rather than an implied synonym.

cases.input: A read at a hub, a stock transition, a lineage link and a dispatch milestone arrive as four facts about one consignment.
cases.expect: They bind to WM-FLW-004, WM-FLW-012, WM-FLW-013 and WM-ECO-024 respectively; no generic logistics-event identity is created and none of the four is derived from another.

cases.input: Custody of SH transfers to the carrier; the customer has not accepted.
cases.expect: Custody transfer is recorded on WM-FLW-004 handover with a time-bounded WM-FLW-013 custody interval; title is unchanged and no WM-ECO-024 receipt, inspection or acceptance assertion exists.

cases.input: A posted inventory movement of 100 units is found to have been 90.
cases.expect: An appended WM-FLW-012 compensating posting of -10 cites priorAssertionRef, correctionReason and recordTime; the original posting remains readable and the prior balance state is preserved.
All four times are separately carried in RFC 3339 with seconds and explicit offsets across the binding; no join substitutes one for another and the posting time does not become the effective time.

cases.input: A stock position is bound with no derivationMode.
cases.expect: The binding is refused; snapshot and projection are distinct constructs and neither is a default.

cases.input: One derived balance sums a source snapshot for site W with a partial posting ledger for site X, with no perimeter declared.
cases.expect: The derivation is refused for mixed modes and an absent completeness perimeter; the partial ledger cannot be read as complete.

cases.input: WM-FLW-011 is reused for SH with no kind declared.
cases.expect: The reuse is refused; trade-shipment, transport-consignment and combined view are not interchangeable and no kind is defaulted.

cases.input: A single generic LogisticsEvent root is proposed to carry reads, stock transitions, lineage links and milestones.
cases.expect: The root is refused; it would duplicate WM-FLW-004, WM-FLW-012, WM-FLW-013 and WM-ECO-024.

cases.input: The profile is extended to hold its own lot status field as the quantity and status of record.
cases.expect: The extension is refused; the profile owns binding constraints only and no business-object identity, lifecycle or quantity of record.

cases.input: A runtime identifier is minted for the profile so bindings can be addressed.
cases.expect: The allocation is refused; newRuntimeId is false and no catalogue, registry or runtime identifier is created here.

cases.input: A physical count differing from the derived balance is applied directly as a stock adjustment.
cases.expect: The adjustment is refused; a count is an observation and authorizes no posting, and any correction is an appended explicit event by the posting authority.

cases.input: All six units of SH are reported delivered because the dispatch milestone exists.
cases.expect: The inference is refused; dispatch does not establish delivery and S6 remains dispatched only.

cases.input: The five received units are reported accepted, one of them carrying a damage exception.
cases.expect: The inference is refused; receipt does not establish inspection and inspection does not establish acceptance or discharge, and inspection determination authority is an external gap.

cases.input: A wrong posted quantity is fixed by editing the stored posting row.
cases.expect: The edit is refused; corrections append successors, prior states remain readable and identifiers are never reused.

cases.input: A placeholder model identifier is written for the Lot or Transformation Event binding so the profile can resolve.
cases.expect: The write is refused; both candidates stay modelId null, registryId null, allocationState unassigned, and identifier invention is forbidden.

cases.input: The profile is described as installable and publication-ready because all six bases are named.
cases.expect: The claim is refused; all bases are reviewable drafts with canonicalPublishable false and outstanding absence-of-external-review holds.

cases.input: Lot L is affected, so every unit of the shared SKU is scoped into the recall and same-SKU units of other lots are additionally declared unaffected.
cases.expect: Both moves are refused; SKU-level scope is never derived from an affected lot, same-SKU and BOM-only matches are notEvidenced, no unaffected declaration is made absent a closed perimeter, and exposure analysis is not recall authority.
